lines: We stood together when the horns sounded, and we are both still here. I will remember that.
The raiders came expecting frightened villagers. They did not expect the two of us.
When the last banner fell, I knew the village would see another morning because we fought together.
I heard the victory bell over all that noise. You made sure there was a village left to ring it.
You did not leave me alone in that fight. That means more than any emerald I could offer.
Raiders remember strong walls. I will remember the person who stood beside me when ours were tested.
We drove them back step by step. I trust you more after sharing ground like that.
The village is standing, the beds are warm, and the workstations are waiting. We earned that ordinary morning.
They brought axes, banners, and bad intentions. We sent every one of them away together.
There is a difference between visiting a village and defending one. After that raid, you are one of us.
I thought the bell might be the last sound I heard. Then I saw you still fighting beside me.
We were outnumbered, not outmatched. I would stand with you again.
That victory belongs to everyone who held the line, and your name has a firm place in it.
You helped turn a day of fear into a story this village will tell with pride.
The raid broke against us. Whatever comes next, I know what kind of ally you are.
